risk_note: RV2 (platform config + identity tokens + app.module). D10-255 ① (staging deploy of main failed: stream exited because identity's token key provider demanded the signing key). New JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM (one P-256 SPKI PEM; must match JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM when both are set). identity splits the signing and verify-only key providers: api (the only issuer of access tokens) still requires the private key and kid in staging / prod and refuses to start with a public key only; stream mounts the verifier only through IdentityModule.forRoot({tokens:'verify'}) and cannot sign (TokenSigningUnavailable), starting with JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM + JWT_KEY_ID; JWT_VERIFY_KEYS_JSON rotation unchanged; token format and ES256 unchanged; local / test with no JWT_* keep the previous in-process key (frozen stream fixtures). JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM redacted and listed in .env.example (name only). Fast and full verification passed on the AWS test machine; required CI checks run on the PR head. After merge ops injects JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM + JWT_KEY_ID into the staging stream and redeploys.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with one S2 (local / test without JWT_* keep a signing key on stream, accepted per brief 9.2 #6), couli-runs/B1-02zj/review-money-r1.json; Codex unavailable until 10-30 (approvals #36)

spec_test_review.note: rule tests written by an independent Claude through claude-run.sh impl --phase test in 2 attempts (Codex unavailable, approvals #36; the orchestrator only ran prettier and reworded one comment to avoid a gitleaks false positive); red/3 PASS (49 tests); reviewed by fresh claude-run.sh sessions: r1 fail (S1 x2: api entry fixture lacked the field keyring; expiry not exercised), r2 pass (couli-runs/B1-02zj/review-spec-r1.json, review-spec-r2.json)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
